notes.title: Release Week
notes.notes:
[p]After an incredible four-year journey and feedback from over ten game conventions, we are thrilled to announce that [b]Lighthaze World[/b] finally has a release date![/p][p align="start"]Immerse yourself in a cozy puzzle adventure set in a charming, non-linear world. Explore serene landscapes inspired by our team's favorite real-life hiking trails, solve thoughtful puzzles, and help an anxious hero overcome their fears to rescue their loyal dog. It's the perfect escape for fans of relaxing, story-driven games.[/p][p align="start"][b]Mark your calendars:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Game Release:[/b] October 24th (North America) / October 25th (Australia & NZ)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Soundtrack Release:[/b] The following day! Composed by Tweaklab, "Breathe, Rest, Repeat" is a serene reimagining of the game's music—a calming album of ambient pads and gentle piano melodies designed to guide you into a state of deep calm.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bundle:[/b] A game + soundtrack bundle will be available at launch![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]This has been a labor of love, and we can't wait for you to finally experience it.[/p][p align="start"][b]Wishlist Now on [/b][/p][p align="start"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747190/Lighthaze_World/"][/dynamiclink]
Join our Discord for launch day giveaways and more: [url="https://discord.gg/JJAV7yvbhp"]https://discord.gg/JJAV7yvbhp[/url][/p][p][/p]
